summary: tickTracedWithHalts adds halted preorder leaf indices while preserving tick and tickTraced results. Collect at the two existing abandonment points, before resetting subtree memory: reactive preemption and finishing Parallel. A cursor chooses the live child of a memory/reactive composite; zero finished markers choose a running Parallel child at these points. Traverse these paths iteratively rather than reporting every leaf in the cleared subtree, which would include idle or completed actions. No extra state history is needed, so states from ordinary tick calls can be resumed with halt tracing. Reports follow abandonment-event order, then preorder inside each branch; events are not globally sorted and repeated activations can repeat an index. Equal leaf values still have distinct node occurrences. Only the optional API allocates a halt collector/walk stack. The per-tick cost also includes both O(state) array copies. Independent reference interpreters track Running leaf lifetimes rather than deriving them from cursor encoding; additive fixture operation15 preserves existing operation12 bytes. This source finding does not establish package publication or current native acceptance.
title: Report halted behaviour-tree occurrences before clearing live paths
